sections.one: Nvidia shares plunge amid a leadership crisis surrounding CEO Jensen Huang, while hotter US inflation data fuels aggressive Federal Reserve rate hike expectations. 135511236212568

What's happening

Company news

  • Nvidia - Plunged 8% to 9% in after-hours and premarket trading following reports concerning CEO Jensen Huang, triggering a board review, shareholder class actions, and political scrutiny. 13464133531324412515

Signals

  • Positive: Strong foreign institutional capital inflows into Indian equities; robust underlying demand for AI infrastructure demonstrated by CoreWeave's earnings. 1210013073
  • Negative / risks: Stubborn US inflation raising the probability of aggressive Fed tightening; severe "key man" and governance risks at Nvidia threatening the broader AI supply chain. 12362125681446413044

sections.one: Indian equities extended their winning streak for a third consecutive session, driven by aggressive foreign institutional buying and easing crude oil prices, pushing the market cap to $5.4 trillion.
sections.html:
What's happening

Signals

sections.one: Tata Power’s strong Q2 earnings and major renewable expansions contrast with legal challenges over international arbitration, while green energy investments surge in Andhra Pradesh.

What's happening

Signals

  • Positive: Strong Q2 earnings and margin expansions reported by major power producers; massive private capital commitments (ReNew, CleanMax) into state-level green energy infrastructure.

sections.one: Massive foreign capital inflows are bolstering NBFC balance sheets, even as the sector faces potential regulatory scrutiny on private equity ownership and localized rural credit stress.

sections.one: Persistent inflation drives widespread price hikes across dairy and tobacco, squeezing margins and hitting quarterly earnings for FMCG majors.
sections.html:
What's happening

  • Input cost inflation drives price hikes: Rising operational and input costs have forced widespread price increases across daily essentials, including milk, ghee, and cigarettes, putting pressure on household budgets and threatening volume growth 120701419914217.

  • Earnings and margin pressures: Earnings reports reflect cost pressures, with P&G Hygiene and Health Care reporting an 8.8% decline in Q2 EBITDA and margin contraction to 22.7% as costs bite 1426314255. Meanwhile, Page Industries shares fell 13% following its Q2 results 14061.

Company news

  • ITC - Raised Gold Flake Regular cigarette prices by ₹10 to ₹135 (its second hike of 2026) to protect margins against higher taxes, and expanded its copier paper portfolio with the launch of Carte Lumina in southern markets 126531320813853.

  • Negative / risks: Widespread inflation driving volume pressures and margin contractions across key players like P&G 1207014263; second round of cigarette price hikes raising risks of consumers shifting to illegal alternatives 12653; regulatory and trade shipment holds affecting spirits players 13957.

sections.one: Nifty Realty surged as developers turned selective on land acquisitions, shifting toward joint development agreements amid robust NCR investments.
sections.html:
What's happening

sections.one: Reliance eyes a massive Rs 43,000 crore coal gasification project in Andhra Pradesh, while Oil India reports mixed Q2 earnings alongside a Rs 7 dividend.

sections.one: Aviation sector faces headwinds from airline capacity cuts and persistent Air India losses, contrasting with strong hotel performance and broker optimism on Lemon Tree and RateGain.

sections.one: Infrastructure activity remains robust with significant metro rail approvals and international expansion, even as margin pressures persist for some domestic EPC players.

sections.one: Q2 earnings for capital goods firms show a mixed bag of strong order books offset by margin compression and execution headwinds.
sections.html:

sections.one: Festive e-commerce sales grew 17% to ₹1.41 lakh crore but missed forecasts due to lower average order values, while Page Industries crashed up to 13% on soft volume growth and margin compression despite a ₹150 dividend.

sections.one: Indian garment exporters are strategically diversifying export markets to mitigate US-dependency risks as demand recovery signals emerge in Western markets.

tabs.name: Tech
tabs.one: Nvidia board weighs dismissing CEO Jensen Huang over security and misconduct probes, while global tech majors navigate supply and hardware shifts.
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • Nvidia's board is preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following reports of a second extramarital affair, with U.S. lawmakers also calling him in for a closed-door briefing over national security concerns regarding an alleged Chinese spy connection 101.
  • SoftBank Group reported an unexpected quarterly net loss of $7.06 billion (1.115 trillion yen) due to heavy data center costs 61.
  • Anthropic acknowledged crossing a major AI safety threshold just days ahead of its planned $1.3 trillion IPO, alongside introducing new workplace tools like Claude Sheets 7276.
  • Festive smartphone sales in India reportedly declined by 20% due to rising consumer prices, though demand for Apple's latest iPhone 18 Pro remained strong 59.
  • Goldman Sachs warned that the massive infrastructure investments in AI face a reality check as returns remain unproven, making the next 18 months critical for the sector 81.

Launches & products

  • Xiaomi 18 Pro Series & Ecosystem: Xiaomi announced a November 17 global launch in Paris for the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, alongside the Watch S5, Smart Band 11, and Clip TWS 20.
  • Vivo X500 Series: Scheduled for an India launch on November 26, the lineup includes the X500, Pro, and Pro Max models, debuting alongside the Vivo Watch GT 2 and a Zeiss Telephoto Converter Kit 3256.
  • Vu Masterpiece AEye TV: Launched in India featuring RGB MiniLED displays, Dolby Atmos, and Google TV integrated with Gemini AI 42.
  • Honor 700 Series: Unveiled with a 9,000mAh Qinghai Lake battery, Snapdragon chips, and a rear display setup 65.

The market angle

  • Bharti Airtel: Introduced a limited-period Buy 1 Get 1 Free offer on popular prepaid recharge plans priced at Rs 349 and Rs 399 62.
  • SpiceJet: Facing severe financial distress, canceling 15-20 daily flights as its active fleet shrinks to just 12 aircraft 66.
  • Reliance Jio: Ranked best in Mumbai for download speeds in the latest TRAI network assessment 102.

Worth reading

  • Why the data center you dread might never even be built: Explores the severe real-world obstacles, local opposition, and energy scrambles stalling the global data center boom 129.
  • CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments: An inside look at how AI cloud providers are altering contract structures and demanding upfront payments to fund rapid infrastructure growth 134.

tabs.name: Auto
tabs.one: Kia India announced a massive $2 billion investment for a second plant in Anantapur, while Maruti Suzuki and Hyundai posted strong double-digit domestic sales growth in October.
tabs.html:
The big stories

  • Kia's Major Capacity Expansion: Kia India announced a $2 billion (approx. Rs 18,800 crore) investment to set up a second plant in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, which will add 2 lakh units of annual capacity and bring its total production capacity to 6.2 lakh units 1819.
  • Strong October Sales for Industry Giants: Maruti Suzuki reported sales of 2,12,384 units (up 20.46% YoY) with six models crossing the 20,000-unit mark, while Hyundai registered 62,799 units (up 16.74% YoY) led by strong demand for the Creta and Venue 2425.
  • EV Market Momentum & Headwinds: Global EV sales returned to growth in October, rising 8% YoY 11, while in India, BGauss crossed 1,000,000 cumulative electric scooter sales 15. However, Vingroup's newly licensed Green SM electric taxi service faced immediate protests from Bengaluru cab unions 22.
  • Input Costs and Margins: CEAT indicated that continued high raw material costs are prompting further tyre price hikes, though it expects gross margins to recover in H1 FY next year if input costs stabilize 21.
  • Global Luxury Shifts: Audi has officially ended production of its flagship A8 sedan after a 32-year run with no direct successor confirmed , and Mercedes-Benz announced a major business overhaul in China following a 31% drop in Q3 sales 31.

Launches & products

  • Honda XR300L: Entered India's dual-sport motorcycle segment, priced at Rs 1,83,000 7.
  • TVS ’82 Series Collection: Special racing heritage collection introduced based on the RR 310, RTR 310, RTX 300, and Ronin 17.
  • VinFast EVs: The Vietnamese manufacturer patented a new electric scooter and motorcycle in India 12.

The market angle

  • Kia Corporation / Suppliers: The $2 billion Anantapur plant investment signals aggressive medium-term volume expansion in the Indian market 18.
  • Maruti Suzuki & Hyundai: Robust October sales figures point to healthy festive season demand and strong inventory absorption 2425.
  • CEAT: Margin pressures persist due to raw material costs, pointing to potential near-term pricing actions across segments 21.

Worth reading

  • Kia India Announces Second Plant In Anantapur: Essential reading for understanding capacity shifts among top Korean automakers in India 18.
  • CEAT sees more tyre price hikes: Good insight into component-level inflation and margin recovery timelines for auto ancillaries 21.
  • Vingroup's ₹8/km electric cabs get Karnataka licence: Highlights the regulatory and ground-level union friction facing new EV fleet entrants in metro cities 22.
